cases.expected: No bytes are written to the context buffer and the method returns immediately.
cases.description: When the context already signals EOF, encode must exit without touching the buffer.

group: Full block encoding without line separator

input.value: new Context(eof=false, modulus=0, lbitWorkArea=0, pos=0, currentLinePos=0)

cases.expected: Encoded bytes in context buffer equal to the ASCII string "NBSWY3DP" (no padding, no line separator). Context.eof remains false, context.modulus ends as 0, context.pos == 8.
cases.description: A normal 5‑byte input should produce exactly one Base32 block of 8 characters. No line‑splitting is configured, so the output is written directly.

group: Full block encoding with line separator (chunking)

input.value: new Context(eof=false, modulus=0, lbitWorkArea=0, pos=0, currentLinePos=0, lineLength=8, lineSeparator="\r\n".getBytes())

cases.expected: Encoded bytes equal to "NBSWY3DP\r\n" (8 Base32 chars followed by CRLF). Context.currentLinePos resets to 0 after the separator.
cases.description: When a lineLength of 8 is configured, the encoder must insert the lineSeparator after each full block of 8 encoded bytes.

input.value: new Context(eof=false, modulus=0, lbitWorkArea=0, pos=0, currentLinePos=0)

cases.expected: After processing the single byte, a second call with inAvail = -1 (EOF) writes "ME======" to the buffer (2 data chars + 6 padding chars). Context.eof becomes true, context.modulus stays 1.
cases.description: When the stream ends after only one octet, the encoder must emit two Base32 characters derived from the high‑order 5 bits and the remaining 2 bits, then pad to a full 8‑char block.

input.value: new Context(eof=false, modulus=0, lbitWorkArea=0, pos=0, currentLinePos=0)

cases.expected: After a subsequent EOF call (inAvail = -1) the buffer contains "MFRA====" (4 data chars + 4 padding chars).
cases.description: Two remaining octets should produce four Base32 characters before padding.

input.value: new Context(eof=false, modulus=0, lbitWorkArea=0, pos=0, currentLinePos=0)

cases.description: Three octets produce five Base32 characters followed by three padding characters.

input.value: new Context(eof=false, modulus=0, lbitWorkArea=0, pos=0, currentLinePos=0)

cases.expected: After EOF (inAvail = -1) the buffer contains "MFRGGZA=" (7 data chars + 1 padding char).
cases.description: Four octets should yield seven Base32 characters and a single pad character.

input.value: new Context(eof=false, modulus=0, lbitWorkArea=0, pos=0, currentLinePos=0)

cases.expected: Encoded output equals "7777777Z" (the standard Base32 representation of the unsigned byte sequence 255,238,221,204,187). No exception is thrown.
cases.description: Bytes with the high bit set must be treated as unsigned values (added 256) before being shifted into the work area.

group: Line separator not added when currentLinePos < lineLength

input.value: new Context(eof=false, modulus=0, lbitWorkArea=0, pos=0, currentLinePos=0, lineLength=12, lineSeparator="\n".getBytes())

cases.expected: Buffer contains "NBSWY3DPGEZDGNBV" (first 8 chars from the first 5‑byte block, then 8 chars from the next 4‑byte partial block plus padding). No line separator is inserted because currentLinePos never reaches 12.
cases.description: When the configured lineLength is larger than the amount of data encoded in a single call, the encoder must not insert a separator.

input.value: new Context(eof=false, modulus=0, lbitWorkArea=0, pos=0, currentLinePos=0)

cases.description: Passing a null input array should cause a NullPointerException when the method attempts to read input[inPos].
Providing a null Context should result in a NullPointerException when the method accesses context fields.

input.value: new Context(eof=false, modulus=5, lbitWorkArea=0, pos=0, currentLinePos=0)

cases.description: When EOF is signaled (inAvail < 0) and context.modulus holds an illegal value (5), the switch‑default branch throws IllegalStateException.

input.value: new Context(eof=false, modulus=-2, lbitWorkArea=0, pos=0, currentLinePos=0)

cases.description: A negative modulus value also falls through to the default case, causing IllegalStateException during EOF handling.

group: Input array index out of bounds

cases.description: If inPos + inAvail exceeds the length of the input array, the loop will attempt to read past the array bounds, throwing ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException.

cases.description: When lineLength > 0 and the encoder needs to insert a line separator, a null lineSeparator array leads to a NullPointerException during System.arraycopy.
